title: Release day leaves every role's permissions as they were
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin, {User-A}, after the Part Lifecycle build was deployed.
  • Custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PERMS) was created before the deployment with, in the parts inventory group, View and Create & Edit ticked and Delete unticked.
  • Screenshot {Screenshot-A} records every permission ticked in {Role-A} before the deployment.
  • User {User-B} is a staff login you hold, with role {Role-A} since before the deployment.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, then click Roles & Permissions.
  2. Click the edit (pencil) button of {Role-A}.
  3. Compare every card with {Screenshot-A}.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. In a second browser, or a private window, sign in as {User-B}.
  6. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  7. Click any part row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Exactly the same permissions are ticked as in {Screenshot-A}; under the renamed group "Part Library and Inventory", View and Create & Edit are ticked and Delete is not. No permission was added, removed or moved.
  • Step 6: {User-B} can open the Inventory list, as before the deployment.
  • Step 7: The part dialog opens for {User-B} without a Delete Part button, as before the deployment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S12-N1, S12-R6, S8-R12, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-N1: “No permission is added, removed or re-keyed. Every user's access on release day is identical to the day before.”
  • S12-R6: “On Administration → Roles & Permissions → Edit Role, the permission group is titled "Part Library and Inventory".”
  • S8-R12: “Delete Part in the part dialog requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission. Without it the button is not shown.”
